summary: FASE 3 frontend-only testing (no backend). Verified /inventarios page (chips, search, category filter, dense table), full CRUD via ProductFormModal (validation, create, service toggle, edit prefill, delete), and both core done-when criteria: (A) editing stock in Inventarios reflects live on POS cards (AGOTADO + disabled at 0, stock badge when positive, price sync), (B) a POS sale decrements catalog stock (p18 12 -> 10 after qty 2 Efectivo checkout; p17 sold out to 0 -> AGOTADO). Dashboard 'Alertas de Stock' derives from catalog and shows CRÍTICO. Regression on POS (add-to-cart, discount amount/percent, transfer proof-or-reference gate, Efectivo/Transferencia/Cxc checkout, /pos/caja, /pos/cuentas-por-cobrar, sidebar Inventarios navigates with no 'Pronto') all passed. Zero JS console errors / pageerrors across all runs.

integration_issues.flow: POS cart quantity vs available stock
integration_issues.issue: Cart allows qty greater than available stock (added Bloqueador SPF50 with stock 11 and reached qty 15; checkout succeeds and stock silently clamps to 0 via Math.max(0, ...)). Over-sold units are lost with no warning/cap.

action_items: Consider capping cart qty at available stock (or showing a warning) so sales cannot exceed inventory; currently decrementForSale clamps at 0 silently.

catalogStore.updateProduct uses `price: Number(data.price) ?? p.price` — Number('') is 0 and Number('abc') is NaN, so nullish coalescing never falls back. Guard with Number.isFinite before assigning; same for stock (`Number(data.stock) || 0` turns non-numeric into 0).
Inventarios reuses POS testids for its category filter bubbles (pos-category-*) via shared CategoryBubbles; consider a testId prefix prop for unambiguous targeting.
critical_code_review_comments: No blocking defects found. Store is a clean single source of truth (persist key 'diedo-catalog'); POS ProductGrid, Inventarios and Dashboard all subscribe to useCatalogStore.products so sync is instant on SPA navigation.
deriveLowStock exists in catalogStore but DashboardPage re-implements the same filter/map inline with a hardcoded 5 — DRY: use getLowStock()/deriveLowStock and LOW_STOCK_THRESHOLD.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows passed (1 minor business-logic gap: over-sell not capped)

seed_data_creation: Created transient item 'TEST_Crema Facial' (SKU TEST-01, stock 7, categoría Productos) in localStorage only; cleared via localStorage.clear() in subsequent runs.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All FASE 3 acceptance criteria verified on the public preview URL. State lives in localStorage keys 'diedo-catalog' and POS stores — run localStorage.clear() + reload before each scenario. Useful testids: inventory-search, inventory-new-btn, inventory-form-modal, inventory-field-{name,sku,price,tax,stock}, inventory-type-{product,service}, inventory-cat-*, inventory-branch-*, inventory-form-{save,cancel,error}, inventory-row-<id>, inventory-stock-<id>, inventory-edit/delete-<id>, pos-product-<id>, cart-item-{inc,dec,qty}-<id>, pos-payment-<method>, pos-checkout-btn. Only remaining gap: cart qty can exceed stock.
rca_of_the_issue: Over-sell gap root cause: ProductCard only disables at stock===0 and posStore addItem/increment has no stock ceiling; catalogStore.decrementForSale uses Math.max(0, stock - qty), absorbing the excess silently.
